text: げんきのかけら　たかい　けど　せんとうふのうの　ポケモンが　げんきに　なるの　すごいわ！

structure.jp: せんとうふのうの　ポケモンが　げんきに　なるの
structure.en: the fact that a fainted Pokémon gets well

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb wraps the whole happening up as one thing you can talk about. げんきに　なるの　すごい = 'the way it gets well is amazing'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.explanation: になる after a word means 'become' that. げんきに　なる = 'become well'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど joins two statements with 'but'. たかい　けど = 'it's expensive, but'.
